title: Injectivity of sign monomials
statement: For any set of indices $\iota$, assign to each finite subset $S\subseteq\iota$ the character on sign assignments $x\in\{\pm1\}^{\iota}$ given by $x\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}x_i$. Distinct finite subsets give distinct characters.
